ORDINANCE XXXII OF 1983
ORDINANCE XXXII OF 1983
CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 26th December, 1983]
No. F. 17(1)/83-Pub.-The following
Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general information :--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Code of Criminal Procedure (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1983.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Code of Criminal Procedure Second Amendment Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Amendment of section 497, Act V of 1898

ORDINANCE XXXII OF 1983
ORDINANCE XXXII OF 1983
CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 26th December, 1983]
No. F. 17(1)/83-Pub.-The following
Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general information :--
2. Amendment of section 497, Act V of 1898.---In the Code of
Criminal Procedure, 1898 (Act V of 1898). in section 497, in subsection (1) in
the third proviso, for the full-stop at the end a colon shall be substituted
and there after the following new proviso shall be added namely :
"Provided
further that the provisions of the third proviso to this subsec tion shall not
apply to a previously convicted offender or to a person who, in the opinion of
the Court, is a hardened, desperate or dangerous criminal.".
